session.title: Switchy 1.0.23: Codex image generation through the proxy; Orca duplicate-trust diagnosis
session.purpose: the user launched a brief from the GameTrainers session: Codex's built-in image tool returned HTTP 405 through Switchy; find the cause, fix it, verify end to end, then release and push everything. He then asked whether a Codex 'failed to load workspace requirements' error after an Orca resume was Switchy's doing, and to check Orca's changelog.
outcomes: Codex image 405 root cause: Codex POSTs image requests to {openai_base_url}/images/generations and /images/edits (strings in codex.exe 0.160), i.e. /backend-api/codex/images/generations; Switchy's /backend-api/codex/* wildcard took GET only, so axum answered 405 locally.

Fix 4041a413 (1.0.23): the wildcard (handle_codex_backend in proxy/handlers.rs, route in proxy/server.rs) forwards GET and POST with the body and the selected account's login; non-GET gets a 600 s timeout.

Verified on the installed 1.0.23: an empty POST to the image route gets OpenAI's own 400 'Missing required parameter: prompt'; a fresh codex exec with CODEX_HOME=~/.codex generated one image into ~/.codex/generated_images/01a0fff7-.../exec-a2f2c0b3-....png (viewed: blue teacup); a plain text turn returned 'pong'. Orca shells set CODEX_HOME to Orca's managed home, whose images land under that home instead.

Released 1.0.23: private main pushed (4041a413, 7a164a76 brief archive, 08b98151 DMG), public repo republished via scripts/publish_public.sh, GitHub release v1.0.23 on registered2nd/switchy with exe, msi and aarch64 dmg (macOS CI run 37126572701).

'failed to load workspace requirements' in a WSL Codex window (old 0.159.2 app-server, pid 7633) was not Switchy: Orca 1.4.218 appended a second, single-quoted [projects.'/home/agentcode/Worldbuilding-1628SA'] trust table to WSL ~/.codex/config.toml at 12:38 on 2026-10-03 while launching a resume; the existing entry used double quotes, so the file became invalid TOML and every Codex config reload failed. Reproduced on a copied config with a plain login and no Switchy sign-in; Switchy-style sign-in with a valid config change works.
Removed the duplicate block from WSL ~/.codex/config.toml (backup config.toml.bak-dupe-2026-10-03); Codex 0.159.2 and 0.160 both complete turns through Switchy again.

Orca v1.4.219 (2026-10-02) fixes the duplicate write and cleans up existing copies (stablyai/orca PR #23958). the user runs 1.4.218; updating was recommended, not done, because it restarts Orca and its open terminals.
session.latest_summary: 1.0.23 lets Codex's built-in image generation through the proxy; released publicly. A Codex config break after an Orca resume was Orca 1.4.218's duplicate trust write, fixed in Orca 1.4.219.
